verdict.rationale: CDP documents registrable webhooks that deliver real-time HTTP notifications for events across an integration, with at-least-once delivery and wallet-activity subscriptions. The evidence does not show that these webhooks are signed, or that they cover the specific money-movement events the story names (payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed). Transfers are said to track their lifecycle, but nothing ties that lifecycle to webhook events. Missing for 10: evidence of signed payloads or signature verification, documented event types for payment confirmation, payout settlement and conversion execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, money movement emits signed webhooks — payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed — so my system tracks state without polling chains or dashboards

citations.quote: Receive real-time HTTP notifications when things happen across your CDP integration.
watch up to 100 wallet addresses under a single subscription with `wallet.activity.multi`.
